user.title: Add an AIPAI A8 reef light
user.description: Enter the light's IP address on your network (for example {example}). Give the light a DHCP reservation in your router so it doesn't change.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the light. Check the IP address and that it is on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.not_a8: Something answered at that address, but it does not speak the A8 protocol.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This light (same serial number) is already set up.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Store a sunrise/day/sunset/night photoperiod in the light and switch it to schedule mode. The light then runs the day cycle itself, in Home Assistant's timezone, surviving reboots. One flash write per call.

night.name: Night
night.description: Ramp-down reaches 0 %. May be after midnight.

ratios.name: Spectrum ratios
ratios.description: Per-channel percentage of the master curve (w, b, r, g, b2, p, uv, wm). Omitted: the channel set points currently in Home Assistant.

set_manual.name: Set manual
set_manual.description: Switch the light to manual mode and store fixed levels. Use 'off' to park the light dark; it stays dark through reboots. One flash write per call.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Per-channel stored level in percent. Omitted: the levels Home Assistant is currently sending.
